summary: Israeli Defense Minister Katz announced a comprehensive military campaign against PA officials and terror infrastructure in Judea and Samaria, modeled on operations in Gaza, Lebanon, and Jenin. An IRGC-affiliated source claimed Iran tested an anti-destroyer missile above a US Navy vessel 48 hours prior. Iran's Supreme National Security Council announced an imminent declared 'no-shipping zone' in the Persian Gulf extending from the US naval blockade line inward.
key_points: Israeli Defense Minister Katz ordered IDF to prepare for comprehensive war against PA officials, terror infrastructure in Judea and Samaria, including senior targeted killings and resident evacuations. (Source: @pkpoi/143878)
Mohsen Rezaei claimed Iran tested an Iranian anti-destroyer missile above a US Navy vessel for the first time 48 hours prior, asserting Iran's right to respond. (Source: @kianmeli1/91597)

Iran's Supreme National Security Council Secretary Mohsen Razai declared Iran will announce a restricted maritime zone in the Gulf in coming days; any ship entering will face sanctions. (Source: @New_security8200/203659)

IDF spokesman confirmed soldiers eliminated the Palestinian terrorist who stabbed an Israeli civilian near Kfar Otzarim in Samaria; the attacker was killed by a Company Commander from Battalion 411. (Source: @idf_telegram/25075)

Sirens sounded at IDF's Parag post near Ramim ridge; IDF clarified the alert originated from a strike deep in Lebanon on a shared GIS layer with no security incident in Israel. (Source: @N12chat/225416)
IRGC claimed it targeted a CENTCOM unmanned vessel in the Strait of Hormuz; US Captain Tim Hawkins called the claim 'a complete lie.' (Source: @VahidOnline/78257)

Qatar's Foreign Ministry spokesperson stated the war against Iran showed Gulf Arab states cannot rely solely on US strategic partnerships and must pursue self-sufficiency in security. (Source: @SharghDaily/182341)

Israeli parliament member Gali Baharav-Miara reported 27.1% of Israelis live in food insecurity as 28 senior academics demanded parties commit to a national food security plan with 300M shekel first-year budget. (Source: @N12chat/225412)

sections.executive_summary: Israeli Defense Minister Katz announced a comprehensive military campaign against PA officials and terror infrastructure in Judea and Samaria, modeled on operations in Gaza, Lebanon, and Jenin. An IRGC-affiliated source claimed Iran tested an anti-destroyer missile above a US Navy vessel 48 hours prior. Iran's Supreme National Security Council announced an imminent declared 'no-shipping zone' in the Persian Gulf extending from the US naval blockade line inward.
iran: Iran's Supreme National Security Council Secretary Mohsen Razai announced that in coming days Iran will declare a restricted maritime zone in the Gulf, beginning at the area where the US Navy enforces its maritime blockade and extending into Gulf territorial areas; any vessel entering will be added to Iran's sanctions list. (Source: @New_security8200/203659)

Mohsen Rezaei, IRGC-affiliated figure, claimed that 48 hours prior Iran tested an Iranian anti-destroyer missile for the first time above a US Navy vessel, asserting Iran's right to respond to what he called an American 'bloody crime' at a wedding ceremony. (Source: @kianmeli1/91597)

Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf stated on Sunday, September 6, one day after a reported US attack on Iranian oil tankers in the Persian Gulf, that the era of 'proportional responses' has ended, threatening faster and heavier retaliation for any violation of Iranian interests. (Source: @VahidOnline/78256)

The IRGC claimed in a Sunday, September 6 statement that it targeted a CENTCOM unmanned vessel in the Strait of Hormuz that allegedly attempted to enter a zone Iran had declared prohibited; US Captain Tim Hawkins called the IRGC's claim 'a complete lie.' (Source: @VahidOnline/78257)

Iran's Economy Minister Ali Madanizadeh stated Tehran's response to US economic pressure will be 'economic resistance alongside economic reforms,' rejecting the view that sanctions can change Iran's decisions, while the US Treasury Secretary assessed only about 30 million barrels of Iranian crude remain unpurchased by China. (Source: @VahidOnline/78256)

A special delegation from Iran's Armed Forces General Staff arrived in Qatar in recent days to investigate the status of three Iranian pilots reportedly held in Qatari captivity during the war, according to Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson. (Source: @asafroz/53165)
israel: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz announced that Prime Minister Netanyahu and himself have directed the IDF to prepare for a comprehensive war against PA senior officials and associated bodies and all terror infrastructure in Judea and Samaria, aiming for full decisive victory; the plan includes targeted killings, evacuation of residents, demolition of terror infrastructure, and IDF presence in evacuated areas as done in Gaza and Lebanon security zones. (Source: @pkpoi/143878)

IDF spokesman confirmed that following a stabbing attack near Kfar Otzarim in Samaria, forces eliminated the Palestinian terrorist armed with a knife; a Company Commander from Battalion 411 shot the assailant after he attempted to stab soldiers near his vehicle in the village of Idna. (Source: @idf_telegram/25075)

An Israeli was seriously wounded in a stabbing attack at Havat Sha'ar Ha'oz farm near the settlement of Otzarin in Samaria, when a Palestinian terrorist exited his vehicle and stabbed a Jewish man multiple times in the neck before fleeing; the victim was listed in serious-to-critical condition. (Source: @pkpoi/143874)

In the village of Hajja in the Ephraim Brigade area, IDF forces responded to friction between Palestinians and Israeli civilians who entered the village, dispersing the riot which included stone-throwing; forces fired warning shots in the air then at main instigators, with hits identified. (Source: @idf_telegram/25076)

Israeli Prime Minister's Office announced the expanded 'Northern Shield' project for residents up to 9 km from the northern border without adequate shelter, with applications opening 15.09.26, offering grants up to 182,000 shekels for mamad construction and a budget of approximately 4.2 billion shekels covering about 11,000 housing units. (Source: @almogboker78/18141)

(Source: @pkpoi/143878)

lebanon: IDF Arabic spokesman called for evacuation of marked areas in Deir El Zahrani in southern Lebanon, asking citizens to stay at least 300 meters away from Hezbollah terror positions and infrastructure. (Source: @shin_persian/9512)

Sirens sounded at IDF's Parag post near the Ramim ridge; the IDF clarified the alert was triggered by a strike deep in Lebanon that appeared on a shared GIS layer, with no security incident on the Israeli side. (Source: @N12chat/225416)

Lebanese sources reported heavy machine gun fire directed toward the town of Al-Mansouri in southern Lebanon following Israeli military operations against Hezbollah positions overnight. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/389401)

Following overnight Israeli army attacks on Hezbollah positions, Lebanese civilians were reported evacuating southern Lebanon while cursing Khamenei and Naim Qassem to move away from the danger zone. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80444)
Warplanes activity was reported over the Bekaa Valley and southern Lebanon airspace, according to local live-mapping sources. (Source: @redlinkleb/41317, @redlinkleb/41322)
syria_iraq: A Hebrew-language analysis cited claimed Trump is compelled to intensify war against Iran to achieve victory, reflecting regional escalation pressure. (Source: @kianmeli1/91590)
gulf_states: Qatar's Foreign Ministry spokesperson stated that the war against Iran demonstrated Gulf Arab states cannot rely solely on US strategic partnerships for security and must pursue self-sufficiency as the way forward, while still needing partners and allies. (Source: @SharghDaily/182341)

Iran's Supreme National Security Council Secretary declared Iran will announce a restricted maritime zone in the Gulf beginning at the US Navy blockade line and extending into Gulf waters, with any entering vessel added to Iran's sanctions list. (Source: @New_security8200/203659)

Financial Times reported that Saudi Aramco's Jizan refinery, with a production capacity of 400,000 barrels per day, was attacked again on Monday as the latest in a series of Houthi attacks that have kept the facility out of service for weeks; diesel shipments from the site dropped to zero in August. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/389421)

sections.threat_assessment: The convergence of Israeli preparations for a comprehensive Judea and Samaria operation, Iranian maritime exclusion zone declarations in the Gulf, and claimed Iranian anti-destroyer missile testing above a US vessel signals a multi-front escalation trajectory. Defense Minister Katz's directive to model the West Bank operation on Gaza/Lebanon security zone approaches — including resident evacuation and sustained IDF presence — indicates a significant operational escalation against PA-affiliated infrastructure. Iran's declared 'no-shipping zone' extending from the US blockade line creates a direct challenge to US naval operations in the Persian Gulf and raises collision risk. The IRGC's claim of an anti-destroyer missile test, denied by US Central Command, highlights the information warfare dimension accompanying the kinetic escalation.
sections.regional_response: Qatar publicly broke with the framework of exclusive reliance on US strategic partnerships, framing the war against Iran as having demonstrated the need for Gulf Arab self-sufficiency in security while still maintaining alliances. Iran's Armed Forces delegation traveled to Qatar to investigate pilots reportedly captured during the conflict, indicating an active bilateral channel despite public rhetoric. Saudi Aramco's Jizan refinery, with 400,000 barrels/day capacity, remained offline following repeated Houthi attacks, with diesel shipments at zero in August, showing sustained Houthi pressure on Saudi energy infrastructure. Yemeni warplanes reportedly conducted over 11 strikes on Houthi positions in Al-Baydha Governorate, indicating continued internal Yemeni conflict dynamics.
sections.intelligence_notes: Multiple channels reported the same Iranian maritime exclusion zone declaration from different angles — Razai's official statement, the US National Security Advisor's confirmation, and Hezbollah-aligned outlets — suggesting coordinated messaging around the Gulf initiative. The IDF's clarification that the Parag post siren was a GIS-layer artifact from a Lebanon strike indicates potential inter-theater alert coordination issues worth monitoring. Iran's Economy Minister's statement on 'economic resistance alongside economic reforms' and reported US Treasury assessment that only ~30 million barrels of unpurchased Iranian crude remain with China suggest the economic dimension of the conflict is being used as a pressure lever. The reported arrival of an Iranian Armed Forces delegation in Qatar to investigate captured pilots indicates Iran-Qatar communications remain active even amid public escalation rhetoric.
